method: Resample 16 raw seed IDs with replacement as shared blocks across all six starters, ages, and histories. Weight distinct original seed pairs by w_i*w_j; exclude self-pairs. Compute within-starter pair rates, then equally weight six starters. Primary visual scores use whole-seed blocks. Percentile 95% intervals.

adultShape.condition: neutral care; within-starter pairs; normalized shape distance >=10%

distinctLife.condition: neutral care; within-starter pairs; shape >=10% at two or more grown ages

visualEvolution.condition: primary agent scores >=2; six starters, sixteen seeds, four histories

limitations: Conditional on this small fixed cohort and the numerical definitions.
Visual intervals do not include reviewer error; score and threshold disagreements are reported separately.
No claim of independently sampled frames/pairs, global uniqueness, human preference, or device performance.
